gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-batak: Urban and blunt, Capture It stands on a towering x-height with a rounded-nib look and no swelling at the stroke ends. Noto Sans Batak is the friendlier voice, a sans with a wide e that never looks pinched, so body text could sit a size or two smaller.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-benga: Noto Sans Bengali reads contemporary and easygoing, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase and every letter mouth standing open. And Capture It, with its nearly sealed letters, gives the page a tight, tall headline voice for that openness to lean against.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-bhaik: Capture It cuts its tall letters like ribbon of constant width, with openings so slight they almost seal shut. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki loosens things up.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-brahm: Noto Sans Brahmi reads light and open, with a high mean line. Past the heading's wire-thin monoline skeleton, a long run of text moves along smoothly, with each curved letter left slightly unclosed and the eye never snagging.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-bugin: Capture It glides under the eye like a single wire. Noto Sans Buginese has open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs and short ascenders, so it is worth giving the body text a little extra size to keep it comfortable.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Commanding and urban, Capture It draws r, n and m with arches that match their stems and a towering x-height above them. Noto Sans Buhid sits beneath, modern and spacious.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-caria: Capture It hums along at a flat, constant line weight, its tall letters nearly sealed shut. Noto Sans Carian then loosens the page, a plain sans whose terminals spread apart like open scissor blades.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-chakm: Noto Sans Chakma reads approachable and uncrowded, its lowercase packed up toward the capitals while the s and c stay open. And across a long passage it would feel easy and unhurried, a plain sans that lets Capture It's sealed, tall letters stay up front.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-cham: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Cham gives tall rounded lowercase forms and c shapes with plenty of entry space. Capture It, whose round bowls never swell or taper, can take the larger size while the body text drops a step.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-chero: Noto Sans Cherokee reads approachable, a tall band of letters with short stalks above and an e left gaping at its terminal. Capture It, with zero stroke modulation and nearly sealed letters, supplies the tight urban counterpoint above it.
